decisions.reason: As a flagship product line close to the core practice software and the firm's digitalisation path, it is likely at or near aspiration levels and would be protected by available slack for further refinement.

Because the education institute extends existing training and customer relationships, management would likely retain it unless it clearly and persistently underperformed relative to moderate aspirations.
The analytics dashboard fits the firm's established software offer and strategic move toward more efficient connected practices, so management would usually continue it while learning about demand.
A complete practice bundle is very close to the established business and likely supports cross-selling and customer retention, making withdrawal relatively unlikely.

Because the listing portal is distant from the firm's core capabilities and likely more prone to falling short of aspirations after several years, management would reallocate those resources to the core business or nearer innovations.
